_about: Frames from the Meringo Minutes capture that the site shows, and how each is cropped. tools/crop_frames.py reads this. box is [left, top, right, bottom] in the 2560 x 1600 original's pixels; the output is scaled to width 1280, and nothing else is done to it. A frame NOT-FOR-PUBLICATION.md lists is refused unless its entry says, in clears, what the crop removes; frames 15a, 15b and 15c are refused whatever the entry says.

crops.name: summary-top
crops.why: The top of the summary: the Checked mark, All 11 claims traced, and the timestamps beside each point. Cut above the waveform and player. NOT-FOR-PUBLICATION.md lists 01a to 01d under use-with-care only: Discussion Notes shows the sentence at 0:37 that merges two facts and the one at 2:13 that gives the wrong cause, and the demo beside it marks both.

crops.name: ask-refusal
crops.why: The Ask tab refusing the day-rate question, the one the hero quotes. Cut below the answer; the rest of the frame is empty.

crops.name: transcript-cue
crops.why: After clicking the 1:33 timestamp on a summary point: the transcript open on that line, highlighted, with the playhead parked at 01:33. This frame exists only in the dark appearance, so both themes show it. Cut to the content column from the 01:07 line down through the player. NOT-FOR-PUBLICATION.md lists 04b under use-with-care: it shows locker for locum, close in 8 for close intake, gag read for agreed, and Dana credited with a line Priya says; the page says so beside the picture.

crops.name: ask-cited
crops.why: The Ask tab answering a question the meeting does answer, with the transcript line it cites at 0:37. Cut to the content column from the meeting title down through the citation; the rest of the frame is empty.
